_comment: The halo behind Karens Unleashed's type: the letters over again,
without their outline, blurred until they read as light rather than
This replaces a Photoshop drop shadow that could not be reproduced —
canvas has no equivalent of its Spread or Contour, so the faithful
translation came out flatter and weaker than the original. Drawing the
glyphs a second time and blurring them is not an approximation of that
effect; it is the effect, built the way the reference thumbnails' own
`blur` is the gaussian radius. `layers` is how many times the blurred
copy is stacked — one pass at this alpha is barely there, and stacking
is how the halo gains body without turning into a hard edge.
`color` is the light itself, and it is white for every line INCLUDING
the highlighted one: the halo is what the type is lit by, not
something the type emits, so it does not change when a line changes
colour. (null instead makes each line glow in its own colour.)
